description: MMS gate: run the inline esm-spec 6.6 tests of problems/advection_1d_inflow_weno5.esm (model AdvectionWENO5Inflow, test mms_steady_inflow_weno5) at the problem's default resolution (N=64) through each binding's official simulation pathway. Exercises the open-boundary WENO5 inflow/outflow first-derivative rule weno5_D_inflow_bc (fifth-order interior WENO5-Z conservative flux difference, reduced-order WENO3 one-sided reconstruction near the walls, prescribed inflow ghost gL at the left wall and non-reflecting zeroth-order extrapolation at the right wall). Pins the WENO5 lowering (ic wiring at t=0) and bounds the steady-drift transport error at t=0.1. The assertions and their tolerances live in the problem file itself; this manifest only routes the runners.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
